welcome.heroTitle: Turn your career history into a long-term digital asset
welcome.heroSubtitle: CareerOS is a Career Operating System: resumes are just views, career data is the asset. Import resumes, accumulate experience, auto-match jobs, and generate multi-language resumes and cover letters in one click.
welcome.feature1Desc: Experiences, projects, skills and achievements stored in one place — every resume is generated from here.
welcome.feature2Desc: Paste a JD and let AI score it against your career data, so you see exactly what's missing.
welcome.feature3Desc: Generate Chinese / English / Japanese resumes in one click, and use AI to draft cover letters and negotiation scripts.
welcome.feature4Desc: Watch hiring channels for new roles by keyword, auto-collect and match them against your profile.
